title: Record the twelve-call and fourteen-call central words
body:
## Summary
- The twelve-call diagonal word, six X labels and six Y labels, sends three registers to `Z_1`, `Z_w` and `Z_{w^2}` on every element of the group of order 64.
- A fourth register stays fixed. The earlier composite schedule realizes the same three outputs in 14 calls.
- No new kappa. Shorter words are not searched.
